blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-source remote sensing image classification benefits from complementary spectral and structural information. However, identifying discriminative cross-modal features remains challenging. This letter proposes a Cross-Layer Refinement and Frequency-aware Fusion Network (CRFNet) within a lightweight dual-branch architecture. Specifically, a Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) module propagates selected attention relationships across successive layers and employs top relation selection to progressively strengthen discriminative spatial dependencies while suppressing irrelevant responses. Furthermore, a Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) module combines frequency-wise interactions with cross-modal channel attention in the Fourier domain. The resulting representations are then converted into spatial-domain gates to selectively modulate complementary features. Experiments on the Houston 2013 and Augsburg datasets demonstrate that the proposed CRFNet consistently outperforms several state-of-the-art methods. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/oucailab/CRFNet
blocks.zh: 多源遥感图像分类得益于互补的光谱和结构信息. 然而,确定歧视性的跨模式特征仍然具有挑战性。 这封信建议在轻量级双分支架构内建立一个Cross-Layer Refinement and Centre-aware Fusion Net(CRFNet). 具体地说,一个跨莱尔优化关注模块将选定的关注关系传播到相继各层,并采用顶层关系选择,逐步加强歧视性的空间依赖性,同时抑制不相干的反应。 此外,一个有频率意识的聚变(FCF)模块结合了频率与傅里叶域的跨模式信道的相互作用。 由此而来的表现再被转换为空间-域门来有选择地调节互补特征. 关于2013年休斯敦和奥格斯堡数据集的实验表明,拟议的通用报告格式网络的业绩一贯超过几种最新方法。 这些代码可在https://github.com/oucailab/CRFNet上公开查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Multi-source remote sensing data classification combines observations of the same scene from heterogeneous sensors [ 1 ] . By integrating complementary information acquired from different sensors, it provides a more comprehensive characterization of land-cover properties than relying on a single data source. Among these data sources, hyperspectral images (HSIs) provide abundant spectral information, and the detailed spectral signatures enable the discrimination of land-cover categories with similar visual appearances [ 2 ] . Hence, HSI is particularly valuable for fine-grained classification [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 多源遥感数据分类结合了不同传感器对同一场景的观测[1]. 通过综合从不同传感器获得的补充信息,它比依赖单一数据来源更全面地描述土地覆盖特性。 在这些数据来源中,超光谱图像提供了丰富的光谱信息,详细的光谱特征使得具有类似视觉外观的陆地覆盖类别得以区分[2]. 因此, HSI对于精细的分类特别有价值[3].

blocks.en: However, HSI commonly suffers from limited spatial resolution and high spectral redundancy, which may hinder the accurate characterization of spatial structures. Therefore, integrating HSI with complementary data, such as synthetic aperture radar (SAR) or light detection and ranging (LiDAR), offers an effective way to jointly exploit spectral, structural, and elevation information [ 4 ] . The all-weather, day-and-night imaging capability of SAR data enables reliable observations under cloud cover or poor illumination [ 5 ] . LiDAR data captures accurate elevation and three-dimensional geometric information [ 6 ] . Motivated by these complementary properties, this letter investigates the fusion of HSI with LiDAR or SAR data for land-cover classification.
blocks.zh: 然而,HSI通常受到空间分辨率有限和光谱冗余度高的影响,这可能妨碍空间结构的准确定性。 因此,将HSI与合成孔径雷达(SAR)或光探测和测距(LiDAR)等补充数据相结合,为共同利用光谱、结构和高程信息提供了一个有效途径[4]。 合成孔径雷达数据具有全天候、昼夜成像能力,能够在云覆盖或光照差的情况下进行可靠的观测[5]。 LiDAR数据捕捉准确的海拔和三维几何信息 [6]. 受这些互补特性的推动,本信调查了HSI与LiDAR或SAR数据在土地覆盖物分类上的结合.

blocks.en: Accordingly, the fusion of multi-source data has attracted considerable attention in land-cover classification. Existing methods generally integrate heterogeneous observations at the data, feature, or decision level [ 7 ] . Among these strategies, feature-level fusion provides a flexible means of combining complementary representations learned from different modalities. Bi et al. [ 8 ] employ a synergistic Mamba fusion module to dynamically align and integrate optical and elevation features through cross-modal spatial interactions at the encoder level. Gong et al. [ 4 ] propose RSCNet, which selects task-relevant HSI bands using cross-source guidance and adaptively fuses them with SAR or LiDAR features through cross-source attention and local–global refinement. Zhang et al. [ 9 ] progressively fuse multi-source features through multi-scale alignment and adaptively gated cross-modal attention, combining the outputs of all stages using learnable fusion weights. Effective fusion remains challenging because different sensors exhibit substantial discrepancies in imaging mechanisms and spatial characteristics.
blocks.zh: 因此,多来源数据的聚合在土地覆盖分类中引起了相当大的关注。 现有方法一般在数据、特征或决定一级综合了各种不同的观测结果[7]。 在这些战略中,特征层面的融合为结合从不同模式中汲取的补充表述提供了灵活手段。 Bi等人 (英语). [8] 利用协同的曼巴聚变模块,通过编码器层面的跨模式空间相互作用,动态地对接和整合光学和高程特征. 龚等人. [4] 提出RSCNet,它利用跨源导线选择与任务相关的HSI波段,并通过跨源注意力和本地-全球改进,适应性地使其与SAR或LiDAR特性相连接。 张等. [9] 通过多规模的对齐和适应性地锁定跨模式的注意,利用可学习的聚变权重,将所有阶段的产出结合起来,逐步使多源特性融为一体。 有效的聚变仍然具有挑战性,因为不同的传感器在成像机制和空间特征方面显示出巨大的差异。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed Cross-Layer Refinement and Frequency-aware Fusion Network (CRFNet) for multi-source remote sensing classification. The dual branches extract features from HSI and SAR/LiDAR data, respectively. Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) blocks progressively refine features through cross-layer interactions, while Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) modules integrate complementary information across modalities at successive stages.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: 拟议的多源遥感分类跨莱尔改进和频率认识网络(CRFNet)概述。 双重分支分别从HSI和SAR/LiDAR数据中提取特征. 跨Layer Refinement Refinement(CLRA)块块通过跨层次的相互作用逐步完善特征,而频率感知补充聚变(FCF)单元则在相继阶段整合了不同模式的互补信息.

blocks.en: Despite these promising advances, two key challenges persist in multi-source remote sensing data classification: ➊ How to progressively identify and strengthen discriminative features. In multi-source feature extraction, complementary cues are often intertwined with noise and background interference, making it difficult to isolate features that reliably distinguish land-cover classes. This challenge calls for a progressive refinement mechanism that preserves informative features and increasingly focuses feature aggregation on task-relevant cues. ➋ How to jointly reinforce shared cross-modal features and preserve modality-specific complementary cues. Most existing fusion strategies that primarily emphasize cross-modal similarity may suppress useful differential features, while indiscriminate aggregation can introduce irrelevant information. The challenge therefore lies in selectively retaining complementary differential cues that enhance class discrimination.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些有希望的进展,但在多源遥感数据分类方面仍然存在两项关键挑战: 如何逐步发现和加强歧视性特征。 在多源特征提取中,互补的提示往往与噪音和背景干扰交织在一起,使得难以分离出可靠区分土地覆盖阶层的特征. 这一挑战要求逐步完善机制,保存信息性特征,并日益注重与任务相关的提示。 如何共同加强共同的跨模式特征,并保留特定模式的补充提示。 大多数主要强调跨模式相似性的现有聚变战略可能会压制有用的差异特征,而不分青红皂白的聚合则会引入不相关的信息. 因此,挑战在于有选择地保留加剧阶级歧视的互补差别提示。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose C ross-Layer R efinement and F requency-aware Fusion Net work ( CRFNet ) for multi-source remote sensing classification. Specifically, we introduce Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) , which propagates retained attention relations across successive layers to guide feature refinement. By combining cross-layer guidance with top relation selection, CLRA progressively strengthens discriminative associations while suppressing irrelevant responses. Furthermore, we develop a Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) module to facilitate cross-modal interactions in the Fourier domain. FCF combines frequency interactions with cross-modal channel attention and transforms the aggregated representation into a spatial-domain gate for feature modulation.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议对多源遥感分类进行Cross-Layer R精度和元能认识网工作。 具体地说,我们引入了跨莱尔折射关注(CLRA),它传播了连续几层的注意力关系,以指导特征的改进。 通过将跨层指导与顶层关系选择相结合,上帝军逐步加强歧视性协会,同时压制不相关对策。 此外,我们开发了一个频率感知辅助融合模块,以促进傅里叶域的跨模式互动。 FCF将频率相互作用与跨模式通道的注意相结合,并将汇总的表示转化为用于特征调制的空间域门.

blocks.en: The contributions of this letter are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 本信的稿件概述如下:

blocks.en: • We design CLRA that propagates retained attention relations across successive layers. Cross-layer guidance and layer-wise top- k k selection progressively strengthen discriminative associations. • We develop FCF module that combines frequency interactions with cross-modal channel attention. The obtained features are transformed into a spatial-domain gate to selectively enhance cross-modal information. • Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed CRFNet outperforms several state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们设计了CLAD,这种传播在不同的层次上保持了关注关系。 跨层指导和分层的上-k-k选择逐步加强歧视协会。 我们开发了FCF模块,将频率相互作用与跨模式通道关注结合起来. 获得的特征被转化为空间域门,有选择地增强跨模式信息. • 对两个基准数据集的广泛试验表明,拟议的通用报告格式网络的绩效超过了若干最新方法。

blocks.en: II Methodology
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: II-A Overall Framework of the Proposed CRFNet
blocks.zh: 拟议通用报告格式网络的总体框架

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the proposed CRFNet adopts a dual-branch architecture for multi-source remote sensing classification. A 3D convolution first extracts spectral–spatial features from the HSI input, while a convolutional layer encodes structural information from the structural SAR/LiDAR data. Both branches subsequently employ stacked Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) blocks to progressively refine their representations through interactions between features from different depths. Each CLRA block comprises a cross-layer attention unit and a multi-layer perceptron (MLP), with layer normalization and residual connections. At successive stages, Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) modules facilitate cross-modal information exchange by reinforcing shared features and retaining modality-specific complementary cues. The resulting features are fed into subsequent refinement module to produce the land-cover classification map.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,拟议的通用报告格式网采用了多源遥感分类的双分支结构。 3D演化首先从HSI输入中提取光谱-空间特征,而一个演化层则从结构SAR/LiDAR数据中编码结构信息. 两个分支随后都采用堆叠的跨拉耶折射区块(CLRA),通过不同深度的特征之间的相互作用,逐步完善它们的表示. 每个CLRA区块包括一个跨层关注单元和一个多层感应器(MLP),具有层态化和剩余连接. 在相继阶段,频率感知辅助融合(FCF)模块通过加强共享特征和保留特定模式的补充提示,促进跨模式信息交流。 由此产生的特征被纳入随后的完善模块,以制作土地覆盖物分类图。

blocks.en:
In multi-source feature extraction, complementary cues
are often intertwined with noise and background interference,
making it difficult to isolate features that reliably distinguish land-cover classes. To address this issue, we design the Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) to use attention information retained from the previous layer to guide relation modeling in the current layer, and then selects the dominant features to restrict the propagation of irrelevant information. The same spatial CLRA design is applied independently in the HSI and structural branches; their attention masks are not shared. Therefore, CLRA can focus feature aggregation on complementary cues that contribute to class discrimination.

blocks.en: II-C Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion
blocks.zh: II-C 频率认知辅助融合

blocks.en: In multi-source data fusion, most existing fusion models emphasize cross-modal similarity may suppress useful differential features, while indiscriminate aggregation can introduce irrelevant information. To this end, we propose Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) module for multi-source feature fusion. As shown in Fig. 3 , given the hyperspectral features 𝐅 h \mathbf{F}_{h} and LiDAR or SAR features 𝐅 x \mathbf{F}_{x} , three linear projections generate the query 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} , key 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , and value 𝐕 \mathbf{V} representations as: 𝐐 = ϕ q ​ ( 𝐅 h ) , 𝐊 = ϕ k ​ ( 𝐅 x ) , 𝐕 = ϕ v ​ ( 𝐅 x ) , \mathbf{Q}=\phi_{q}(\mathbf{F}_{h}),~~\mathbf{K}=\phi_{k}(\mathbf{F}_{x}),~~\mathbf{V}=\phi_{v}(\mathbf{F}_{x}), (6) where ϕ q \phi_{q} , ϕ k \phi_{k} and ϕ v \phi_{v} denote independent linear mappings. The projected features share the same dimensions C × H × W C\times H\times W . We apply two-dimensional discrete Fourier transform (DFT) to 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} and 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , followed by spatial flattening: 𝐅 q = ℱ ⁡ ( 𝐐 ) , 𝐅 k = ℱ ⁡ ( 𝐊 ) , \mathbf{F}_{q}=\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{Q}),\qquad\mathbf{F}_{k}=\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{K}), (7) where ℱ \mathcal{F} denotes the Fourier transform. Two parallel paths subsequently capture complementary cross-modal interactions. The first computes an element-wise frequency interaction: 𝐏 = 𝐅 q ⊙ 𝐅 k , \mathbf{P}=\mathbf{F}_{q}\odot\mathbf{F}_{k}, (8) which retains interactions at corresponding channels and frequency locations. blocks.en: III Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 三. 实验结果和分析

blocks.en: III-A Datasets and Settings
blocks.zh: 数据集和设置

blocks.en: We evaluate the performance of the proposed CRFNet on two benchmark datasets for multi-source remote sensing data classification. The first is the Houston 2013 dataset, released for the 2013 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest. It covers the University of Houston campus and its surrounding urban areas, USA, and comprises an HSI and a co-registered LiDAR-derived digital surface model. Both modalities contain 349 × 1905 349\times 1905 pixels at a spatial resolution of 2.5 m. The second is the Augsburg dataset [ 10 ] , acquired over Augsburg, Germany, from which we use the co-registered HSI and SAR observations. The scene contains 332 × 485 332\times 485 pixels at a spatial resolution of 30 m and includes seven land-cover classes. Its HSI comprises 180 spectral bands covering 0.4–2.5 μ \mu m, while the SAR data provide complementary microwave scattering information.
blocks.zh: 我们评价拟议的通用报告格式网在多源遥感数据分类的两个基准数据集上的绩效。 第一部是休斯敦2013年数据集,为2013年IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest发行. 它覆盖美国休斯顿大学校园及其周边城市地区,包含一个HSI和一个共同注册的LiDAR衍生数字表面模型. 两种模式都包含349×1905349\times 1905像素,空间分辨率为2.5m. 第二个是奥格斯堡数据集[10],它收购了德国奥格斯堡,我们从中采用了共同注册的HSI和SAR观测. 场景包含332×485332\time485像素,空间分辨率为30m,包含7个土地覆盖类. 其HSI由180个光谱波段组成,波幅为0.4-2.5 μ \mu m,而合成孔径雷达数据提供了补充微波散射信息。

blocks.en: Our experiments were conducted on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU. It is trained for 200 epochs using the AdamW optimizer, with a batch size of 128, a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and an embedding dimension of C = 64 C=64 . To evaluate the performance of the proposed CRFNet, we compare it against other state-of-the-art methods, including S 2 ENet [ 11 ] , DFINet [ 12 ] , AsyFF [ 13 ] , ExViT [ 14 ] , HCT [ 15 ] , MACN [ 16 ] , and RSCNet [ 4 ] . To quantitatively evaluate the experimental results, we employ three metrics: Overall Accuracy (OA), Average Accuracy (AA), and Kappa coefficient. OA and AA are reported as percentages, and Kappa is scaled by 100 in the tables. Accuracy differences are expressed in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验是在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU上进行的. 它使用亚当W优化器为200个时代进行训练,批量大小为128,学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}嵌入维度为C=64 C=64. 为了评价拟议的通用报告格式网的绩效,我们将其与其他最新方法进行比较,包括S 2 ENet [11]、DFINet [12]、AsyFF [13]、ExViT [14]、HCT [15]、MACN [16]和RSCNet [4]。 为了从数量上评估实验结果,我们采用了三个衡量标准:总体精确度(OA)、平均精确度(AA)和Kappa系数。 在表格中,OA和AA作为百分比报告,Kappa的比例为100。 准确性差异以百分点表示.

blocks.en: III-B Parameter Analysis
blocks.zh: 三-B 参数分析

blocks.en: Number of CLRA Blocks. We investigate the effect of the number of CLRA blocks by varying the block number from 1 to 4. As shown in Fig. 4 (a), both datasets achieve their highest OA with three blocks. Adding a fourth block reduces OA, particularly on Augsburg. These results suggest that progressively refining attention benefits feature discrimination, but additional network depth does not necessarily yield further improvements. Therefore, we use three CLRA blocks in our experiments.
blocks.zh: CLRA 块的数目。 我们调查CLRA区块数量的影响,将区块数量从1个改为4个。 如图4(a)所示,两个数据集都以三个区块实现最高的OA. 加上第四个街区会减少OA,特别是在奥格斯堡. 这些结果表明,逐渐改进注意力的好处是歧视,但增加网络深度不一定能带来进一步的改善。 因此,我们在实验中使用了三个CLRA区块.

blocks.en: Ratio in Top- k k Selection. We examine the influence of the top- k k selection ratio by varying it from 0.4 to 0.9. As shown in Fig. 4 (b), the OA on Houston 2013 initially increases, peaks at a ratio of 0.7, and then decreases as the ratio increases further. This suggests that an appropriate selection ratio balances retaining informative attention contributions and suppressing irrelevant ones. In contrast, the performance on Augsburg remains relatively stable across the tested ratios, indicating lower sensitivity to this hyperparameter.
blocks.zh: 在 Top- k 选择中的比例 。 我们通过从0.4到0.9来检查最高-k 选择比例的影响。 如图4(b)所示,2013年休斯敦的OA起初会增加,峰值为0.7,然后随着比例的进一步提高而减少. 这表明,适当的选择比例平衡了保留信息关注贡献和抑制无关贡献。 相比之下,奥格斯堡的性能在整个测试比率上保持相对稳定,表明对这个超参数的敏感度较低.

blocks.en: III-C Classification Performance Comparison
blocks.zh: 三-C 分类业绩比较

blocks.en: Tables I and II report class-wise recall together with OA, AA, and Kappa. On Augsburg, CRFNet achieves the highest OA of 92.04%. Its strongest class-wise results are obtained for low plants and allotment. The corresponding classification maps in Fig. 5 further verify these results. In the enlarged region, CRFNet reproduces the main forest area and the adjacent low-plants region in the ground truth, with little false labeling. It is demonstrated that our CRFNet preserves local land-cover patterns while distinguishing vegetation classes.
blocks.zh: 表一和表二与OA、AA和Kappa一起分类召回。 在奥格斯堡,CRFNet实现了最高的OA,为92.04%. 低档植物和分配物的分类结果最强。 图5中相应的分类图进一步验证了这些结果. 在扩大的区域,通用报告格式网在地面上复制主要林区和邻近的低植区,几乎没有虚假的标签。 事实证明,我们的通用报告格式网络在区分植被类别的同时保留了当地的土地覆盖格局。

blocks.en: On Houston2013, CRFNet obtains the highest OA, AA, and Kappa of 93.75%, 94.39%, and 93.22%, respectively. It ranks first or second in nine of the fifteen classes. In terms of class-wise accuracy, CRFNet achieves the best results for Commercial and Road, reaching 94.02% and 92.82%, respectively, and attains 100% accuracy for Synthetic grass, Soil, and Tennis court. These results demonstrate the strong overall classification performance of our CRFNet on this dataset.
blocks.zh: 在休斯敦2013年,CRFNet获得最高的OA,AA和Kappa,分别是93.75%,94.39%和93.22%. 它在15个班级中的9个班级中排名第一或第二. 在分级准确性方面,CRFNet在商业和公路方面分别取得了94.02%和92.82%的最好成绩,在合成草、土壤和网球法庭则实现了100%的准确性。 这些结果显示,我们通用报告格式网络在这一数据集上的总体分类绩效良好。

blocks.en: III-D Computational Complexity
blocks.zh: 三-D 计算复杂性

blocks.en: Table III compares the parameter counts and FLOPs of different methods on the Augsburg dataset. CRFNet requires only 0.3492 M parameters, achieving the smallest model size among all compared methods. Specifically, it reduces the parameter count by 58.72% and 87.88% compared with DFINet and RSCNet, respectively. In terms of computational complexity, CRFNet requires 0.0821 GFLOPs, ranking second only to HCT. These results demonstrate that CRFNet combines a compact model size with low computational cost.
blocks.zh: 表三比较了奥格斯堡数据集不同方法的参数计数和FLOP. 通用报告格式网只需要0.3492 M参数,实现所有比较方法中最小的模型大小. 具体来说,它分别比DFINet和RSCNet的参数数减少了58.72%和87.88%. 在计算复杂性方面,CRFNet需要0.0821 GFLOPs,排名仅次于HCT. 这些结果表明,通用报告格式网将紧凑的模型规模与低计算成本结合起来。

blocks.en: III-E Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 三-E 读取研究

blocks.en: Table IV presents the ablation results of CLRA and FCF on both datasets. Without either component, the baseline achieves OA values of 90.71% and 89.36%, respectively. Introducing CLRA alone yields gains of 0.53 and 2.67 percentage points. Similarly, incorporating FCF alone increases OA to 91.51% and 92.24%. Combining both components achieves the best OA values. These results demonstrate that both components contribute to classification performance and that their combination provides further improvements on both datasets.
blocks.zh: 表四列示了CLRA和FCF在两个数据集上的衰减结果。 没有这两个部分,基线的有机农业值分别为90.71%和89.36%。 仅采用CLRA就可增加0.53和2.67个百分点。 同样,单是纳入家庭公平系数,就将工作收入提高到91.51%和92.24%。 将两个组件组合起来,就能实现最佳OA值. 这些结果表明,这两个组成部分都有助于分类工作,两者的结合使两个数据集得到进一步改善。

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: We proposed CRFNet, a lightweight dual-branch network for multi-source remote sensing image classification. Specifically, CLRA progressively enhances discriminative spatial dependencies through cross-layer attention refinement and top relation selection, while FCF exploits cross-modal complementary information through bidirectional frequency-domain interactions. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed CRFNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CRFNet,这是一个用于多源遥感图像分类的轻量级双分支网络。 具体地说,CLRA通过改进跨层次的注意力和选择顶级关系,逐步加强歧视性的空间依赖性,而FCF则通过双向频域交互利用跨模式互补信息. 对两个基准数据集的广泛试验表明,拟议的通用报告格式网络的业绩一贯高于最新方法。
